description: This file defines a PHP class named DauxExtension that implements the ConfigurableExtensionInterface. It configures a schema and registers an event listener within the Markdown content type extension for Daux, a documentation generator.

classes.name: DauxExtension
classes.description: A final class implementing a configurably extendable interface that adds schema configuration and event registration for the Markdown content type in Daux.

methods.name: configureSchema
methods.description: Adds 'daux' schema expecting an instance of \Todaymade\Daux\Config to the configuration builder.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers an event listener for DocumentParsedEvent that triggers the AutoTOCAdder's onDocumentParsed method upon document parsing.
